notes:
Helped Ericka resolve the reported site deploy issue for Fabricating Equipment Sales site: https://app.netlify.com/sites/fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/deploys/681966a8ba777c0008c055ce. Upon checking, the deploys that failed shows installation of the netlify-gatsby plugin @netlify/plugin-gatsby@3.8.3 (latest version). It seems Netlify added this by default when no custom configuration was found (netlify.toml) and the issues are caused by package incompatibilities. The Gatsby version used by this project is at 2.19.8 based from the package.json (https://github.com/stackshift/webriqpage-fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/blob/master/package.json#L12) file. Based on this info (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@netlify/plugin-gatsby/v/2.0.0-beta.0#essential-gatsby-plugin---v2-beta) I've found, Gatsby v2 below are only compatible with v1 of @netlify/plugin-gatsby and node version 18/20. Committed change to master branch adding the plugin version https://github.com/stackshift/webriqpage-fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/commit/afb3f0272ea6a1e76ab2e4fe457ca2c55cbd44c3 and updated the Node dependency for the project to use v20
https://app.netlify.com/sites/fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/configuration/deploys#dependency-management. Netlify deploy issue is now resolved: https://app.netlify.com/sites/fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/deploys/6819923b08268c0008e53f9b

module_detail.name: Resolve production and dev branch build errors

notes: Helped investigate and resolve the reported build issues: (1) Updated the Netlify project configuration to use the node version 20 (https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/configuration/deploys#continuous-deployment); (2) Disabled the Netlify lighthouse plugin which seemed to cause the persisting build error even after updates done from point 1 & 2 https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/configuration/deploys#build-plugins;  (3) Redeployed (without cache) the failed production and dev branches; and (4) Confirmed build issues resolved https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/deploys
log_notes: Helped investigate and resolve the reported build issues: (1) Updated the Netlify project configuration to use the node version 20 (https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/configuration/deploys#continuous-deployment); (2) Disabled the Netlify lighthouse plugin which seemed to cause the persisting build error even after updates done from point 1 & 2 https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/configuration/deploys#build-plugins;  (3) Redeployed (without cache) the failed production and dev branches; and (4) Confirmed build issues resolved https://app.netlify.com/projects/quandarycg/deploys

notes:
1. Investigated the error with the build error.
2. Tried different approach from updating the index, [slug].tsx files, updating package.json versions.
3. Tried adding vercel.json configuration but still build error persist.
4. Investigated the last pushed but nothing to be found.
5. Communicated with Mariel F to add the webhook url in sanity to apply the trigger build upon sanity studio changes.
6. Found out that the error is from the scraper produced pages and links that are not available in the studio pages.
7. Removing all links that are errors/not available in studio.
8. Build success.
9. Communicated with Mariel F and Renato with the fixes made and the issues found.
